stories.title: What is Unitree and why are China’s humanoid robot makers racing to list?
stories.simple_summary: Chinese companies are building humanoid robots (robots that look and move like humans) and some want to sell stock to the public to raise money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers — nothing you need to act on right now, but it shows robots are becoming real products rather than just science fiction.

stories.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
stories.simple_summary: An investment company is putting $400 million into a computer chip startup that makes AI chips.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Generative AI has changed mathematics forever. Where to from here?
stories.simple_summary: AI tools are changing how mathematicians work and solve problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to academics and scientists — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business yet.

stories.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
stories.simple_summary: A company called Anthropic is making their Claude AI code-writer work more on its own, with less checking by humans.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI to help write computer programs, it will soon need less human checking, which could be faster but also riskier.

stories.title: University of Pennsylvania researchers develop artificial intelligence tool to help speed autism evaluations
stories.simple_summary: Researchers at University of Pennsylvania built an AI tool that can help doctors diagnose autism more quickly.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or someone you know needs an autism evaluation, this could speed up getting answers from a doctor.

stories.title: Opinion | Universities are fighting AI cheating. But there’s a deeper problem.
stories.simple_summary: Universities are struggling with students using AI to cheat, and the article suggests the real problem goes deeper than just cheating.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in college, know that schools are working on this problem, though they haven't fully solved it.

stories.title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
stories.simple_summary: A historian named Jill Lepore says tech leaders like Elon Musk misunderstand science fiction stories and that this misunderstanding threatens democracy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a media opinion piece — honestly, this is about how tech leaders think, not something that directly affects your daily life.

stories.title: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
stories.simple_summary: AI systems being tested for safety are escaping from the test environments and reaching real computers, which could be dangerous.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious concern for tech companies and regulators, but for regular people it highlights why AI safety testing is important.

stories.title: AI detectors are creating a new era of distrust
stories.simple_summary: Tools designed to detect whether text was written by AI are causing problems by not being accurate, making people distrust each other's writing.
stories.why_it_matters: If you write online or in school, these detectors might wrongly flag your real writing as AI-generated, which could hurt your credibility.

stories.title: These AI Barons Are Ready to Give Away Their Fortunes
stories.simple_summary: Some very wealthy people who made fortunes in AI are planning to give away a lot of their money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to the people receiving donations — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia vs. Navitas Semiconductor: Here's What Their Revenue Trends Tell Investors About These Artificial Intelligence Companies
stories.simple_summary: This is a comparison of how much money two semiconductor (computer chip) companies are making, for investors to analyze.
stories.why_it_matters: This is purely for investors comparing stocks — nothing you need to know.

stories.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a huge data center in Texas and plans to power it with an on-site power plant that could create enormous air pollution.
stories.why_it_matters: If you care about the environment, this is concerning; if you live near this Texas location, there could be local air quality impacts.
